description: The Façade-to-Archetype (F2A) dataset pairs façade images of residential buildings with instruction and response records, so that vision-language models can infer each building's archetype for building energy modelling. It was published on Zenodo on 26 August 2026 (version 1.0.0) by Yangze Liang, Chunbo Teng, Guangyao Chen, Sihao Li and Zhao Xu of Southeast University and Linfei Li of the Technical University of Munich, with an article on an AI-guided façade-to-IDF framework for EnergyPlus. It contains 17,138 residential buildings, 59,884 multimodal samples and 37,253 JPG images. Labels give building type (terraced house, single-family house, multi-family house and apartment block) and construction era in bands starting before 1945. Coverage: residential buildings; the metadata read does not name the countries, so scope is recorded as regional. Access: one RAR archive of about 2.9 GB on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: image sources and locations are not stated in the part of the metadata read. Simulation uses: automated assignment of archetypes and thermal attributes for urban building energy models. Related records: the Eurac baseline building models and archetypal.
